purpose: Fixed manual response-language checks. Expected labels are specifications, not measured model results.
session_rule: Start a fresh connection for each case. Keep all turns of one case in that same connection. Check the response after every turn.
scope: Response language only. Do not score TTS naturalness, latency, factual answers, or ASR accuracy with these labels. Inspect the committed transcript to distinguish ASR errors from language-selection errors.

turns.user: Hi, can you tell me more about बैंगलोर

cases.check: The place-name script must not switch an otherwise English answer to Hindi.

turns.user: स्टैंडर्ड tell me more about Burj Khalifa.

cases.check: An isolated transcript prefix must not outweigh the meaning and grammar of the English question.
A clear Hindi question should receive Hindi without requiring a separate language instruction.
Keep a conversational Hindi-English mix instead of translating every English term into formal Hindi.
The explicit English preference outranks the language of the later question.

turns.user: कृपया केवल हिंदी में जवाब दो।

cases.check: The explicit Hindi preference outranks a later English question.

turns.user: Please use Hinglish for this conversation.

cases.check: A requested mixed-language style should not silently become English-only or formal Hindi.

turns.user: अब से हिंदी में जवाब दो। मुंबई के बारे में बताओ।

cases.check: A newer explicit preference replaces the older one and remains active.

turns.user: अब मुंबई के बारे में बताओ।

cases.check: Without an explicit preference, clear changes in the user's language are allowed; the assistant's previous language must not lock the session.

turns.user: Explain what the phrase 'Hindi only' means.

cases.check: Mentioning or quoting a language preference as content must not set that preference.
